title: Latency Deckboard: p50/p95/p99 split by model + route with streaming vs non-stream panes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a unified deckboard style latency dashboard that surfaces p50/p95/p99 for every model-route pair, with side-by-side panes for streaming and non-streaming I/O modes. This ticket covers telemetry ingestion, selector/aggregation semantics, visual layout, and a small set of trace hooks to link from a chart point to a sampled trace. The goal is to make regressions obvious at the model+route granularity while keeping cardinality and cost bounded.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard exposes p50/p95/p99 for all active model-route combinations for the last 24h, 7d, and 30d windows
Streaming and non-streaming panes are rendered side-by-side and can be toggled per-route
Each percentile point links to a trace sample (if available) with one click
Metrics pipeline uses histogram aggregation to avoid per-request storage blowup; bucket boundaries reviewed with telemetry team
Query performance under 1s for common lookups; board paginates/tiles for >200 model-route combos
Playbook section added: how to investigate a p99 spike (traces, logs, recent deploys, model variant fallbacks)
